title: NoMercy plugin repository index
description: The document a NoMercy media server fetches from a plugin repository URL.

plugins.description: Every plugin this repository offers. An empty list is valid.

id.description: The plugin's id, identical to the id in its plugin.json. A Ulid, or the GUID form used by plugins published before the platform settled on Ulid — the server reads both and treats them as the same sixteen bytes, so a plugin keeps its identity, its consent and its grants across the change.

name.description: The plugin's name. The server names the downloaded assembly after this.

version.description: Dotted numeric. This is what the server compares.

downloadUrl.description: A direct link to the .dll. The server fetches this; a browser never sees it.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the file at downloadUrl, lowercase hex. Omitting it means the install cannot be verified.
